headline: Mexico's CFE Plans $1 Billion Capital Raise to Expand Electricity Grid
summary: Mexico's state-owned utility CFE plans to raise $1 billion to expand its power transmission grid by almost 7% during the current presidential administration.
why: CFE dominates Mexico's electricity generation and controls all national transmission, a critical bottleneck for nearshoring industrial investment in the country.

impacts.name: Comision Federal de Electricidad
impacts.why: CFE plans to raise $1 billion to finance a 7% expansion of the transmission grid.
